2607.08152.title: LEXIC: Lightweight Eye-tracking eXtension via Injected Complexity
2607.08152.paper_summary: On the recent EyeBench benchmark, predicting reading comprehension from eye movements exposes a stark gap: text-aware models using pretrained language models reach 56--63% AUROC, while gaze-only models operate at chance. We ask how far a gaze-only model can be pushed by lightweight, language-model-free conditioning. Building on the EyeBench AhnCNN baseline, LEXIC-Base, we propose two mechanisms to inject three precomputed word-level difficulty signals, GPT-2 surprisal, word frequency, and word length, into the per-fixation input: direct concatenation, LEXIC-Concat, and a residual mechanism, LEXIC-Res, where a small head predicts typical-reader gaze response and the encoder is conditioned on the deviation. On the OneStop reading comprehension task, with K=5 seed-ensemble training across ten folds, both mechanisms produce statistically consistent AUROC gains on Unseen Text, +1.8 to +2.2 percentage points, Wilcoxon p <= 0.065. LEXIC-Concat additionally lifts Unseen Reader by +2.9 percentage points, p = 0.010. We trace an architectural boundary in LEXIC-Res on Unseen Reader, +1.8 percentage points, p = 0.19, to the prediction head being calibrated to training readers, transferring imperfectly to out-of-distribution readers.
2607.08152.paper_summary_zh: 在最近的 EyeBench 基準測試中，從眼動作預測閱讀理解暴露出明顯的差距：使用預訓練語言模型的文本感知模型達到 56--63% 的 AUROC，而僅依賴凝視的模型則僅在隨機機率範圍內。我們詢問僅依賴凝視的模型能夠在輕量級、無語言模型的條件下推進多遠。在 EyeBench AhnCNN 基線 LEXIC-Base 的基礎上，我們提出兩種機制，將三個預計算的單詞級難度信號——GPT-2 驚訝度、單詞頻率和單詞長度——注入每次凝視的輸入中：直接串聯 LEXIC-Concat 和一種殘差機制 LEXIC-Res，其中一個小頭預測典型讀者的凝視反應，編碼器則根據偏差進行調整。在 OneStop 閱讀理解任務中，進行 K=5 種子集成訓練，跨越十個折疊，兩種機制在未見文本上均產生統計一致的 AUROC 增益，增幅為 +1.8 到 +2.2 個百分點，Wilcoxon p <= 0.065。LEXIC-Concat 另外使未見讀者提升 +2.9 個百分點，p = 0.010。我們在未見讀者的 LEXIC-Res 中追蹤到一個架構邊界，增幅為 +1.8 個百分點，p = 0.19，這是由於預測頭被調整為訓練讀者，並不完美地轉移到分佈外的讀者。
